faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to register for the Product Specialist (Trade Finance) position at Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. is 12 October 2026. Candidates are encouraged to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues on the portal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess any Graduate or Post Graduate degree from a recognized university under a regular curriculum. Additionally, a minimum of three years of professional experience in handling Trade Finance business is mandatory for all applicants applying for this role.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for TMB recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Product Specialist (Trade Finance) recruitment. All categories of candidates are exempted from paying any application charges as per the official notification released by Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Product Specialist post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the post is between 28 years and 38 years as of 31 August 2026. The bank has also mentioned that in deserving cases, the age limit may be relaxed, providing flexibility for highly experienced candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TMB Product Specialist vacancy?
faq.answer: You can apply by visiting the official TMB careers portal at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/. You need to register, verify your email via the activation link, fill in your details, upload the required documents, and submit the application form online.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Product Specialist (Trade Finance) position consists of a Personal Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience will be called for the interview round to assess their suitability for the banking role.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: Yes, the position of Product Specialist (Trade Finance) is a regular (full-time) role within Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. The salary and benefits provided for this position are as applicable to regular officers (M / SM) within the bank's organizational structure.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open for candidates across India. As long as you meet the educational and experience requirements specified in the notification, you are eligible to apply for the position regardless of your current state of residence.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the online application?
faq.answer: During the online application process, you will need to upload a scanned photograph and signature. You should also keep your educational certificates and proof of experience (covering at least three years in Trade Finance) ready for reference and potential verification during the interview stage.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be found on the TMB careers website at https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/. It is highly recommended that all applicants download and read the document thoroughly before initiating the online registration process to ensure full compliance with the eligibility criteria.
